notes: Compatibility is extracted from the ROM's per-species teachable-move tables.
Engine-level teachable-move rules are applied in addition to the raw ROM arrays.
Mew is special-cased by the engine to learn all 50 TMs and all 8 HMs in this machine set.
TM10 Hidden Power, TM21 Frustration, TM27 Return, and TM43 Secret Power use the engine's universal-move rules.
TM-illiterate species only receive a universal TM if that move is also in their level-up learnset under the configured Gen 6+ TM-literacy behavior.
Pyukumuku is explicitly blocked by the engine from Hidden Power, Return, and Frustration.
The per-species arrays may contain move-tutor moves too; this export filters them out and includes only TM01-TM50 and HM01-HM08.
This compact file lists only compatible TMs/HMs for each species/form.
